* Body

The checkout canary deployment began rejecting valid sessions at 14:23 UTC after the JWT refactor hit production. Mira triggered the automatic rollback within four minutes, limiting impact to under two hundred requests. Root-cause analysis revealed that the new token expiry check did not handle leap-second boundaries correctly, causing a one-second window where all tokens appeared expired. The rollback preserved customer trust but delayed the rollout by two days.
